summary: The hand-back checker in evidence/accuracy/check.py loads its bundled default settings from evidence/data/accuracy_defaults.json (constant DEFAULT_SETTINGS_RESOURCE = "data/accuracy_defaults.json", read via importlib.resources; the docstring confirms this is the bundled copy of associate's accuracy.json). In that file: retry_rounds = 2, refusal_cap = 3, min_quote_length = 8 (and version = 1). The loader is load_default_settings, defined at evidence/accuracy/check.py:64 with signature -> tuple[dict[str, Any], int]; it re-parses the file on every call and returns (settings, settings["version"]). The constant listing the supported walk format versions is SUPPORTED_WALK_FORMATS: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2) at evidence/accuracy/check.py:59. Task was read-only: no file was changed. One environment fault: ledger_append/ledger_list are unavailable (ledger is not on PATH), so nothing could be recorded in the work ledger; finish is used to record this instead. Not checked: the byte-identical-to-associate claim (associate/contract/accuracy.json at commit 266dad3 was not fetched), whether the loaded defaults are consumed elsewhere, tests were not run (none needed for a read-only lookup), and memory only surfaced an unrelated matcher_vectors note.
